Ascribe{H3051} unto Jehovah,{H3068} O ye sons of the mighty,{H1121} Ascribe{H3051} unto Jehovah{H3068} glory{H3519} and strength.{H5797} 2 Ascribe{H3051} unto Jehovah{H3068} the glory{H3519} due unto his name;{H8034} Worship{H7812} Jehovah{H3068} in holy{H6944} array.{H1927} 3 The voice{H6963} of Jehovah{H3068} is upon the waters:{H4325} The God{H410} of glory{H3519} thundereth,{H7481} Even Jehovah{H3068} upon many{H7227} waters.{H4325} 4 The voice{H6963} of Jehovah{H3068} is powerful;{H3581} The voice{H6963} of Jehovah{H3068} is full of majesty.{H1926} 5 The voice{H6963} of Jehovah{H3068} breaketh{H7665} the cedars;{H730} Yea, Jehovah{H3068} breaketh{H7665} in pieces the cedars{H730} of Lebanon.{H3844} 6 He maketh them also to skip{H7540} like a calf;{H5695} Lebanon{H3844} and Sirion{H8303} like a young{H1121} wild-ox.{H7214} 7 The voice{H6963} of Jehovah{H3068} cleaveth{H2672} the flames{H3852} of fire.{H784} 8 The voice{H6963} of Jehovah{H3068} shaketh{H2342} the wilderness;{H4057} Jehovah{H3068} shaketh{H2342} the wilderness{H4057} of Kadesh.{H6946} 9 The voice{H6963} of Jehovah{H3068} maketh the hinds{H355} to calve,{H2342} And strippeth{H2834} the forests{H3295} bare: And in his temple{H1964} everything saith,{H559} Glory.{H3519} 10 Jehovah{H3068} sat{H3427} [as King] at the Flood;{H3999} Yea, Jehovah{H3068} sitteth{H3427} as King{H4428} for ever.{H5769} 11 Jehovah{H3068} will give{H5414} strength{H5797} unto his people;{H5971} Jehovah{H3068} will bless{H1288} his people{H5971} with peace.{H7965}
